title: Opening homes, supporting carers
titleZh: 打开家门，也支持照护者
summaryZh: 英格兰招募寄养照护者的新宣传活动强调多种参与方式，同时支持已有照护者。
levelReason: 编辑估计A2：短句、具体家庭照护情境和常见时态为主；寄养等专门词配中文释义。

source.title: National call to recruit more foster carers launched at Number 10

sentences.text: Some children in England need a safe and supportive home with a foster family.
sentences.zh: 英格兰一些儿童需要一个由寄养家庭提供的、安全且支持他们的家。

sentences.text: A foster carer looks after a child who needs this kind of care.
sentences.zh: 寄养照护者照顾需要这种照护的儿童。

sentences.text: On 14 October 2026, the Department for Education announced a new national campaign to find more carers.
sentences.zh: 2026年10月14日，英国教育部宣布开展一项新的全国宣传活动，寻找更多照护者。

sentences.text: The campaign asks adults to learn more before deciding that fostering is not for them.
sentences.zh: 这项活动请成年人先多了解情况，不要过早认定寄养照护不适合自己。

sentences.text: It especially hopes to reach people in their thirties and forties who have not seriously considered it before.
sentences.zh: 它尤其希望接触此前没有认真考虑过此事的三四十岁人士。

sentences.text: The government wants to create 10,000 new foster places by the end of this Parliament.
sentences.zh: 政府希望在本届议会任期结束前新增10,000个寄养名额。

sentences.text: This is a target, not the number of new places already available.
sentences.zh: 这是一个目标，并不是已经提供的新名额数量。

sentences.text: Some new programmes will test more flexible ways to help, including care at weekends.
sentences.zh: 一些新项目将试验更灵活的帮助方式，包括周末照护。

sentences.text: Other programmes will offer training or help children move from residential care into foster families when this meets their needs.
sentences.zh: 其他项目将提供培训，或在符合儿童需要时，帮助他们从机构照护转入寄养家庭。

sentences.text: The changes aim to support existing carers too, not only recruit new ones.
sentences.zh: 这些改变也旨在支持已有照护者，而不只是招募新人。

sentences.text: Better information and support should help carers understand the process at each stage.
sentences.zh: 更好的信息和支持应有助于照护者理解各阶段的流程。

words.note: supportive是形容词，修饰home，意为给予支持的。
carer是可数名词，前有a；本句说明寄养照护者的职责。
campaign指有组织的宣传活动；这里不是节日或旅程。
foster places指寄养名额；10,000后用复数places。
more flexible ways表示更灵活的方式；周末照护是具体例子。

sentences.note: 留意本句中的固定搭配，并结合中文对照复述完整意思。

questions.text: What information would help someone understand the role of a foster carer?
questions.zh: 哪些信息有助于人们了解寄养照护者这一角色？

expressions.note: 可替换后面的内容，讨论类似情境。
